test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

FRIEND
solution: The correct answer is '**Foe**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Friend**' is '**Foe**'. • **Friend**: a person that you know and like (not a member of your family), and who likes you. [मित्र, दोस्‍त (जो परिवार का सदस्‍य नहीं है)] • *Example: Seema and I are old **friends**. We were at school together.* • **Foe**: an enemy. (शत्रु, दुश्‍मन) • *Example: His **foe** was a worthy antagonist.* **Correct Answer:__** *Foe.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Helper**: a person who helps (especially with work) [सहायक] • **Companion**: a person or animal with whom you spend a lot of time or go somewhere. [साथी, सखा, सहचर (मनुष्‍य या पशु)] • **Partner**: the person that you are married to or live with as if you are married. (विवाहित या विवाहित जैसे जीवन का संगी या साथी) 32:T9a9, The correct answer is '**Amanable**'.
